title: The backend a run actually used, and reuse refused where it is not known
note: scientific.backend_probe and scientific.run_identity (D-2026-94): the runtime probe (NumPy's dispatched CPU features, every bundled OpenBLAS found by its distribution's RECORD and asked its kernel, the system C and math libraries by their bytes) independent of import order; the native build by its installed bytes as well as its RECORD; backend_status digested with the identity; an UNRESOLVED backend recomputed, never reused; the governed identity and its bundle computed from the one probed environment. BK27-BK33 (D-2026-97): NumPy's per-function runtime dispatch and each OpenBLAS's runtime thread count and threading model recorded, unresolved when unanswered; GLIBC_TUNABLES a backend variable.

mutations.name: BK1_the_probe_reads_what_the_process_loaded
mutations.replace:
bundled = [b for b in _bundled_blas()
               if b["distribution"] in __import__("sys").modules]
mutations.rationale: the BLAS recorded is the one this process happened to import first, so the identity check and the run disagree

mutations.name: BK2_scipys_blas_is_not_recorded
mutations.rationale: scipy.linalg runs on an OpenBLAS the identity never names

mutations.name: BK3_the_kernel_is_assumed
mutations.rationale: the kernel is written down rather than asked, and a BLAS that cannot say is taken as resolved

mutations.name: BK4_the_blas_bytes_are_assumed
mutations.rationale: a BLAS library replaced or unreadable is recorded as the same bytes

mutations.name: BK5_an_unresolved_blas_part_is_not_flagged
mutations.rationale: an UNRESOLVED kernel or library leaves the runtime RESOLVED

mutations.name: BK6_a_missing_math_library_is_not_flagged
mutations.find:
if name not in OPTIONAL_LIBRARIES:
                unresolved.append(f"lib{name}")
mutations.rationale: the loader cannot find libm and the backend is still RESOLVED

mutations.name: BK7_the_math_library_is_not_recorded
mutations.rationale: libm -- every exp and log -- is outside the identity

mutations.name: BK8_a_relative_mapping_is_believed
mutations.rationale: a maps line naming no absolute file is taken for the library the loader resolved

mutations.name: BK9_the_probe_imports_numpy_at_import
mutations.replace:
from pathlib import Path
import numpy  # noqa: F401

RESOLVED = "RESOLVED"
mutations.rationale: the top-level scientific interfaces need NumPy merely to state an identity

mutations.name: BK10_the_runtime_never_reaches_the_environment
mutations.rationale: the probed backend is computed and dropped: a different kernel is the same environment

mutations.name: BK11_installed_bytes_are_not_hashed
mutations.rationale: a library replaced after installation changes nothing the identity records

mutations.name: BK12_a_modified_build_is_not_noticed
mutations.rationale: bytes that no longer match the wheel's RECORD are called RESOLVED

mutations.name: BK13_an_unreadable_file_is_skipped
mutations.rationale: a native file that cannot be read is left out instead of making the record UNRESOLVED

mutations.name: BK14_the_byte_cache_ignores_a_rewrite
mutations.rationale: a file rewritten in the same process keeps the digest of its old bytes

mutations.replace: if False and any(n.get("status") != "RESOLVED" for n in natives.values()

mutations.name: BK17_status_without_a_probe_is_resolved
mutations.find: if not isinstance(runtime, dict) or runtime.get("status") != "RESOLVED":

mutations.name: BK18_an_unresolved_backend_is_reused
mutations.rationale: two runs that could not say which backend they ran on are reused as the same

mutations.name: BK19_only_the_prior_status_is_checked
mutations.find: for which, ident in (("prior", prior), ("current", current)):
mutations.rationale: a current run on an unresolved backend reuses a resolved prior

mutations.name: BK20_backend_status_is_not_digested
mutations.rationale: an unresolved and a resolved identity digest the same

mutations.name: BK21_the_governed_identity_is_not_probed
mutations.rationale: the worker's identity never asks the runtime, so it is UNRESOLVED and never reusable

mutations.name: BK22_the_bundle_describes_another_environment
mutations.rationale: the bundle's environment and the identity's are computed differently and disagree

mutations.name: BK23_a_missing_loader_is_not_flagged

        unresolved.append("dynamic loader")
mutations.rationale: the dynamic loader cannot be found or read and the backend is still RESOLVED

mutations.name: BK24_no_numpy_is_a_crash
mutations.rationale: a model that never uses NumPy has no identity in an environment without it

mutations.name: BK25_an_unidentified_blas_is_assumed
mutations.find: if "openblas" not in name or "numpy" not in have:
mutations.rationale: a NumPy on MKL, Accelerate or a system BLAS is RESOLVED with its linear algebra unnamed

mutations.name: BK26_an_unbundled_scipy_blas_is_assumed
mutations.rationale: scipy.linalg runs on a BLAS nobody named and the backend is RESOLVED

mutations.name: BK27_the_dispatch_is_a_constant
mutations.rationale: the record names a dispatch whatever NumPy actually chose

mutations.name: BK28_an_unanswered_dispatch_is_not_flagged
mutations.find:
if dispatch is None:
        unresolved.append("numpy runtime dispatch")
mutations.rationale: a NumPy that cannot say what it dispatched is called resolved

mutations.name: BK29_the_dispatch_digest_is_over_names_only
mutations.rationale: two processes that dispatch the same functions to different targets get one digest

mutations.name: BK30_the_thread_count_is_assumed
mutations.rationale: the thread count is the host's CPU count, not what the library will run

mutations.name: BK31_an_unanswered_thread_count_is_not_flagged
mutations.rationale: a BLAS that cannot say how many threads it runs is called resolved

mutations.name: BK32_an_empty_dispatch_table_is_an_answer
mutations.replace:
if not rows and False:

mutations.rationale: an empty table -- nothing dispatched, nothing said -- reads as a dispatch

mutations.name: BK33_glibc_tunables_are_not_recorded
mutations.rationale: a tunable masking libm's FMA/AVX2 variants changes nothing in the identity
